Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent did not effectively identify or confirm the precise mouth of Crum Creek using authoritative sources such as GNIS or USGS. This oversight led to an incomplete or potentially inaccurate understanding of the watercourse's mouth.
